stages.name: Prepare Procurement Specification
stages.instruction: Consume the supplied mature procurement baseline directly. Do not redo requirements, NFR, solution-design or ADR work. Produce the vendor-neutral procurement specification while preserving Hard minimum / Target / Preference / Unknown states exactly. Only after the complete artifact is produced, append the exact final line `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: PROCUREMENT_SPECIFICATION`.

stages.name: Expand Procurement Market
stages.instruction: Consume only the supplied procurement-specification handoff. Before substantive work, require the exact upstream marker `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: PROCUREMENT_SPECIFICATION`. If absent, return only `UPSTREAM_INCOMPLETE: PROCUREMENT_SPECIFICATION` and stop. If present, broaden market/source coverage beyond the incumbent-reseller set without inventing newly verified products or facts. Only after the complete market-expansion artifact is produced, append the exact final line `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: MARKET_EXPANSION`.

stages.name: Verify Procurement Options
stages.instruction: Consume the procurement-specification and market-expansion handoff plus the supplied candidate evidence. Require `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: MARKET_EXPANSION` before substantive work. Verify candidates only against supplied exact-model evidence and preserve Target/Preference misses as non-hard. Missing evidence remains Unknown / verify. Do not invent approval authority or product facts. Only after the complete verification artifact is produced, append the exact final line `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: PROCUREMENT_VERIFICATION`.
